- **"Don't use the old one."** Pressure to act fast and skip your usual check.

- **"Safe account"** — no police force, embassy or government ever asks you to move money to a "safe account". There's no such thing.

- **They want your savings** — the whole point is to get you to send money yourself, so it can't be reversed.

What to do:
1. Don't reply, and don't share codes, passwords or account details.
2. If you're worried, contact your real embassy or local police using a number you look up yourself — not one they gave you.

- Don't send money or share ID/banking details with them.
